covered_report_window: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Friday, August 14, 2026 U.S. market close and before the Monday, August 17, 2026 U.S. market open
market_context_summary: U.S. equities were slightly lower but near record highs after July retail sales fell 0.6% and preliminary August consumer sentiment dropped to 51.0; Bitcoin was near $63,068, leaving crypto-miner economics under pressure into a weekend-gap earnings event.

ranked_companies.timing: Friday, August 14, 2026 after market close; conference call Monday, August 17 at 8:00 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Realized HPC revenue/ARR conversion and Bitcoin-mining gross margin
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: A current-quarter revenue miss could outweigh the AI contract; 22.5% short float could also squeeze sharply
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The new sovereign-AI contract and crowded shorts create relief upside, but weaker Bitcoin economics, a demanding revenue bar, and heavy exchangeable-note financing leave no reliable immediate direction.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Sparse public consensus points to roughly a $0.16-$0.20 loss per share and about $82.75 million of revenue, versus fiscal Q4 revenue of $71.82 million.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Realized HPC revenue and the $35 million ARR base convert cleanly, management de-risks the contracted $70 million ARR deployment, and a less-bad mining quarter triggers a squeeze.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Revenue misses as lower Bitcoin prices and network difficulty compress mining economics, while capital needs and exchangeable-note dilution dominate the forward view.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: HIVE options carried roughly 114% implied volatility in the latest public snapshot; an older event preview indicated a roughly 16.4% move. Short interest reached 60.44 million shares, or 22.5% of float, on July 31.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Coverage is sparse at about three estimates. Published consensus is still constructive on long-term valuation, but HIVE missed fiscal Q4 revenue and EPS estimates and estimate precision is low.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: Material disagreement: Pass A Lean Down (-34), Pass B Lean Up (+42), Pass C Neutral (+8)
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Existing forward-demand proof gate applied: future AI contract value did not substitute for realized ARR conversion or a de-risked deployment schedule.

excluded_high_reversal_or_weak_names.reason: Consensus score of +5 fails the absolute-score threshold and reversal risk of 68 exceeds the 40 ceiling.

research_allocation_view.plain_statement: This is a research prioritization model, not financial advice.

detailed_company_sections.consensus_summary: The three fully independent passes produced -34, +42, and +8 direction scores and 72, 64, and 69 reversal-risk values. The resulting averages are +5 direction and 68 reversal risk.
detailed_company_sections.pass_agreement_pattern: One bearish pass, one bullish pass, and one neutral pass; disagreement is material.
detailed_company_sections.one_sentence_thesis: Forward AI demand is real, but current-quarter conversion and Bitcoin economics are too uncertain for a reliable immediate direction.
detailed_company_sections.what_the_market_expects: Approximately $82.75 million of revenue and a $0.16-$0.20 loss per share from a sparse analyst set.
detailed_company_sections.what_could_make_the_stock_go_up: A clean HPC revenue step-up, reaffirmed $35 million realized ARR plus credible timing for another $70 million contracted ARR, and resilient mining margin could force short covering.
detailed_company_sections.what_could_make_the_stock_go_down: Another revenue miss, margin compression, or capex and dilution commentary could show that the AI narrative is arriving later and more expensively than the market needs.
detailed_company_sections.reversal_risk_assessment: High. The stock has de-risked, short interest is 22.5% of float, and event volatility is elevated, so either a less-bad report or a disappointing conversion update could reverse a headline read quickly.
detailed_company_sections.social_sentiment_read: Investor discussion is strongly AI-bullish but promotional and polarized; recurring dilution complaints are also prominent. No independent customer-sentiment signal was strong enough to affect the score.
detailed_company_sections.options_positioning_read: Public data show very high implied volatility, while exact event-week pricing was not reliable enough to treat as a precise forecast. Short crowding is the more defensible positioning signal.
detailed_company_sections.analyst_revision_read: Long-term ratings remain mostly constructive, but estimates are sparse and HIVE missed fiscal Q4 revenue and EPS; the consensus bar is therefore directionally useful but not precise.
detailed_company_sections.base_case: Reported revenue lands near or below consensus, current HPC conversion is encouraging but not enough to settle the financing debate, and the share reaction is volatile without a durable direction.
detailed_company_sections.bull_case: Revenue clears the low-$80 millions and management converts the AI contract pipeline into credible near-term ARR, producing a sharp relief rally.
detailed_company_sections.bear_case: Mining revenue and margin miss while financing needs and delayed deployments dominate, pushing the stock lower despite the contract headline.
detailed_company_sections.final_directional_judgment: Neutral / No Edge. The averaged score is +5, far inside the neutral band.
detailed_company_sections.allocation_rationale: No allocation: absolute direction score is below 30, reversal risk is above 40, confidence is Low, and disparity is moderate.
detailed_company_sections.disparity_effect_on_conviction: Moderate disparity reduced confidence and eliminated allocation priority even though the averaged score leaned slightly positive.
detailed_company_sections.method_update_note: No new framework change. The existing learned lesson requiring realized forward-demand proof for bullish allocation was applied narrowly.
